pilot_protocol.expected: Independent Python literal projection/join/group counts fixed by descriptions before native execution, no outputs reused as expected
pilot_protocol.acceptance: Each native output equals literal Arrow expected; all three native pairs equivalent under exact values/types/multiplicity; column order significant, row order ignored
pilot_protocol.policy: Only generated pandas RangeIndex ignored with explicit justification; no physical-type relaxation
